levels.native-config: Written into the CLI's own configuration. The CLI is expected to apply it; this framework's tests check that it is rendered, not that the CLI enforces it.
levels.instruction-only: Text the model is asked to follow. Nothing stops an agent that ignores it.
levels.not-rendered: The manifest value does not reach this CLI's files at all.
levels.manual-setup: Works after a one-time step the adapter does not perform.
levels.none: The CLI has no equivalent and the adapter generates nothing.

instructions.detail: `instructions[]` copied to `opencode.json`; the CLI loads those files.

roles.detail: One `agent.<name>` entry per sub-agent, with a prompt that points at its `SUBAGENT.md`.

commands.detail: One `command.<name>` entry per command, pointing at its body in `.agents/commands/`.

lifecycle_hooks.detail: Command bodies call `workflow-transition` and `workflow-run-hook`; no native hook is registered.

skills.detail: `skills.paths` copied; the CLI discovers `SKILL.md` files there.

unsupported: Stack-aware permission overrides for roles other than `implementer`

instructions.detail: `CLAUDE.md` is loaded by the CLI; it points at `AGENTS.md`.

edit_permissions.detail: The permission map is printed in each agent stub. `.claude/settings.json` only pre-allows reading framework files; its `deny` list is empty.

lifecycle_hooks.detail: Command bodies call `workflow-transition` and `workflow-run-hook`; no native hook is registered.

skills.detail: The CLI discovers skills under `.claude/skills/`; link `.agents/skills` there once.

unsupported: Blocking edits to `specs/**` or generated adapters

roles.detail: Roles are sections of `GEMINI.md`; the CLI has no separate sub-agent concept.

edit_permissions.detail: Printed in `GEMINI.md` as a soft permission contract.

skills.detail: `GEMINI.md` tells the model to read `SKILL.md` files under `.agents/skills/`.

instructions.detail: An always-applied project rule; the CLI also reads `AGENTS.md`.

roles.detail: Role pointers in the rule body.

commands.detail: One `.cursor/commands/harness-<name>.md` per command; the prefix keeps user commands untouched.

edit_permissions.detail: The manifest's permission map does not appear in the rule; only the general rule not to edit approved specs does.

lifecycle_hooks.detail: No `.cursor/hooks.json`: no Cursor event corresponds to an SDD transition. Command bodies call the workflow commands.

skills.detail: The rule tells the model to read skills under `.agents/skills/`.

unsupported: Native lifecycle hooks for SDD transitions

instructions.detail: The CLI reads `AGENTS.md`, which is versioned source and never generated.

roles.detail: Described in `AGENTS.md` and the role cards.

commands.detail: No project-level slash commands; a workflow is run by asking the agent to follow `.agents/commands/<name>.md`.

edit_permissions.detail: The CLI has no project file-permission concept.

lifecycle_hooks.detail: Workflow bodies call the workflow commands.

skills.detail: The CLI scans `.agents/skills` from the working directory up to the repository root.

cli_independent_controls.enforced_by: Whoever runs it, and CI on every push and pull request
The command itself; a hand edit of `feature_list.json` bypasses it
`./check.sh` while the feature is in progress, and the `done` transition
Git pre-commit hook once `core.hooksPath` is set, and CI on changed files
`trusted-review.yml` as a required check on the protected default branch

native_validation: The generated files are not validated with the vendors' own CLIs. The suites check that each adapter renders the declared files deterministically; whether a given version of a CLI loads and applies them is not exercised, and a skipped native check is recorded as skipped, never as passed.
native_plugin_packaging: Optional and not shipped. Distributing the framework as a Claude Code marketplace plugin and an OpenCode plugin, which would add real blocking of edits to approved specs and generated adapters in OpenCode, is specified in FEAT-009 (`specs/plugin-packaging/`) and awaits human approval.
